fig1-timeline.caption: Timeline of methodological developments in cardiomyocyte MEA analysis, 2022–2026. The entries are a selection from the studies examined, chosen to show the range of developments rather than to list them: about a third of the post-2022 sources cited in this review do not appear, among them reviews, a non-peer-reviewed acceptance standard, and studies whose contribution is to the recording rather than to the analysis. The figure is therefore not a chronology of the field, nor of the reference list.

fig2-morphology-pipeline.caption: Schematic of a morphology-aware field potential analysis pipeline. Waveform classification determines the analysis branch applied before FPD measurement; rate correction is applied after. The signal-inversion branch is the author's own proposal (Mäki, 2023) and has not been independently validated.
